summary: Bera hf. engages in the production, distribution, importation, and sale of beverages and food products in Iceland. It operates through five segments: Egils Non-Alcoholic, Egils Alcoholic, Danól, Export, and Other. The company produces and distributes bakery products; produces and distributes various food and consumer products; and provides various services, including human resources, finance, digital development, information technology, quality management, sustainability, procurement, and warehouse operations. It also sells groceries and beauty and specialty products; and provides foodservice. In addition, the company offers collagen caffeinated drink under the COLLAB brand; water under the Iceland Spring brand; and bread, rye bread, flatbread, pastries, and cakes for consumers, hotels, restaurants, canteens, institutions, and companies. The company was formerly known as Ölgerðin Egill Skallagrímsson hf. and changed its name to Bera hf. in February 2026. Bera hf. was founded in 1913 and is based in Reykjavik, Iceland.
